title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 24 MARCH 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 24 March 2026. Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Southern, Uva and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts after 2.00 pm. Fairly heavy showers above 50 mm are likely at some places in Ratnapura, Galle and Matara districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Galle, Matara and Kurunegala districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers
